primer: Apar Industries Limited (NSE: APARINDS) is a global leader in power transmission conductors, transformer oils, and specialty cables, founded by Dharmsinh D. Desai in 1958 . In FY26, consolidated revenue reached ₹22,902 Cr (+23.3% YoY; TTM ₹25,605 Cr through September 2026), with 29.77% from exports across 140+ countries led by ~$269M in North America . An August 2026 ₹2,500 Cr QIP lifted reserves to ₹8,478 Cr, cut debt-to-equity to 0.12x, and earned a CARE AA; Stable upgrade . On price-blind fundamentals, APARINDS earned a COMPOUNDER_PASS ( kpi_health: PASS_WITH_WATCH ).
